    n, k, x = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    a = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split()))

    neg_count = sum(1 for ai in a if ai < 0)
    if neg_count % 2 == 0 and k % 2 == 1:
        min_abs = min(abs(ai) for ai in a)
        for i in range(n):
            if abs(a[i]) == min_abs:
                a[i] -= x
                break
    else:
        for i in range(n):
            if a[i] < 0:
                a[i] += x
                k -= 1
                if k == 0:
                    break

    print(' '.join(map(str, a)))
